## PR checklist

- [ ] This comment contains a description of changes (with reason).
- [ ] If you've fixed a bug or added code that should be tested, add tests!
- [ ] If you've added a new tool - have you followed the module conventions in the [contribution docs](https://github.com/amd-ph-core/modules/tree/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Make sure your code lints (`nf-core modules lint`).
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated.
- [ ] `README.md` is updated (including new tool citations and authors/contributors).
